Break down this recipe into prep steps and cook steps: Quick Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta. Ingredients: 8 oz linguine or fettuccine, 1 lb large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), half tsp red pepper flakes, quarter cup fresh lemon juice, half cup grated Parmesan, quarter cup fresh parsley, salt and pepper to taste. Instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, reserve half cup pasta water before draining. Sear the shrimp in olive oil and butter over medium-high heat, 1-2 minutes per side, then set aside. Make the sauce by sauteing garlic and red pepper flakes in the same skillet for 1 minute. Add lemon juice and reserved pasta water, simmer 1-2 minutes. Toss in pasta, shrimp, Parmesan, and parsley until coated evenly, adjust seasoning, and serve immediately.
